remarks: Wonderful Old Hill Location, walk to elementary school, down town for concerts at the Levitt, The Library, shopping, restaurants and walking trails along riverfront.  2 BR, 2.5 BA condo is a desirable end unit. Living Room has 9' vaulted ceiling and fireplace, with glass door opening to a private patio and small yard, perfect for outdoor entertaining and gardening.The kitchen and dining room are open to the living room , making entertaining easy. The upper level includes 2 bedrooms with full baths, walk-in closets, and washer & dryer in closet. The condo includes a 2 car tandem under condo garage, guest parking & great storage place.The condo roof is 6 years old and was painted in 2021. Just 0.5 miles to downtown and 3 miles to Longshore and beach. Don't miss great opportunity.
